items.title: Tommy Ridgley Interview, 1986-03-22
items.q: Mike Ginnard. He's a big man in the fire department... But Mike was one of the members of the Pink Elephants. I used to play for them quite a bit.

ctx.x: Uh huh. Came up. Came up, yeah. To Canal Street? Yeah, came up to Canal Street, and went, and then we went back down, we went back down Ramport Street. But, and we played from about 10 o'clock to 5 o'clock that evening, but it was hard. We had some fun. And it didn't make no whole lot of money either. Never was a whole lot of money, but it was so much fun. And you know, that's part of recognition. You know, there was a white organization I used to play for, the Pink Elephants. I don't know if you ever heard of…
